title: COP31 Collapses: The Longest Climate Summit Ever Ends With No Deal
description_html:
The UN climate conference in Antalya, Turkey, ran almost two days past its deadline and ended with no overall deal, the longest COP ever. We explain what the failed text said about fossil fuels, how oil-producing countries blocked coal, oil and gas language, what Tuvalu, Ireland, Australia and the UN Secretary-General said, and what it means for India as heat, floods and bad air will not wait for a treaty.

Listen on Spotify and watch on YouTube: Global Meridian with Bikesh Roy.
